episodes.title: Game On
episodes.summary: When 12-year-old Evan is cut from The Ducks, he and his mom try to build a new kind of hockey team.

episodes.title: Dusters
episodes.summary: Evan is skeptical of Alex's unique approach to coaching, as the team gets ready for its first game.

episodes.title: Breakaway
episodes.summary: Alex tries to be a coach. Evan recruits Sofi and the team receives unexpected help from Bombay.

episodes.title: Hockey Moms
episodes.summary: Bombay helps Don't Bother moms versus Ducks moms. Sofi is hanging by a thread.

episodes.title: Cherry Picker
episodes.summary: Evan's rocker dad unexpectedly shows up, complicating things for Evan, Alex, and even Bombay.

episodes.title: Spirit of the Ducks
episodes.summary: With the original Ducks team back, Evan and Bombay consider where their loyalty lies.

episodes.title: Pond Hockey
episodes.summary: With the team mad at Evan, and Alex unsure of her coaching skills, Bombay brings them somewhere new.

episodes.title: Change on the Fly
episodes.summary: With the State Tournament on the horizon, Alex realizes she likes winning more than she thought.

episodes.title: Head Games
episodes.summary: Don't Bothers road trip to States! Teen drama unfolds, Alex is left behind, Bombay reveals a secret.

episodes.title: State of Play
episodes.summary: The Don't Bothers are forced to choose what's really important, as they face the Ducks at States.

episodes.title: Ice Breaker
episodes.summary: The Ducks and Alex head to a summer hockey institute run by hardcore former NHL player Coach Cole.

episodes.title: Out of Bounds
episodes.summary: EPIC training kicks off, pushing our Ducks, especially Nick, to the brink. Alex faces off with Cole.

episodes.title: Coach Classic
episodes.summary: The annual Coach Classic, where coaches take the ice against kids, leads to big drama at EPIC.

episodes.title: Draft Day
episodes.summary: It's Draft Day, and pressure's on for Alex to pull together a team to prove herself to Coach Cole.

episodes.title: Icing on the Cake
episodes.summary: As team practices begin, Evan's caught between hockey and friendship. Alex struggles to help Jace.

episodes.title: Twigs
episodes.summary: Tournament play is rough. Can Alex's summer camp bonding plan give our Ducks a fighting chance?

episodes.title: Spirit of the Ducks Part 2
episodes.summary: The Ducks take an unsanctioned field trip, hoping to fix their game on the day teams pick captains.

episodes.title: Trade Rumors
episodes.summary: Fresh off their visit to the Anaheim Pond, our Ducks fly high. Alex and Cole consider a risky move.

episodes.title: Summer Breezers
episodes.summary: As the Ducks and Dominate get ready to face each other in the Finals, a new plan changes up summer.

episodes.title: Lights Out
episodes.summary: The Ducks strive for their hockey futures at the Summer Showcase. The end of summer means goodbyes.
